name: Gyomei Himejima
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Hashira; Stone Hashira
summary: Gyomei Himejima is the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps and is regarded as the strongest member of his generation. After awakening his Demon Slayer Mark, Gyomei's already extraordinary physical abilities were dramatically enhanced, allowing him to contend with some of the most powerful demons in existence. He continued to demonstrate exceptional combat skill, perception, and adaptability while fighting Kokushibo and Muzan.

stats.range: Several Meters with his chained spiked flail and axe and Breathing Styles

abilities: Master Spiked Flail and Axe Wielder
notes: After awakening his Demon Slayer Mark, Gyomei's strength and speed increased by an order of magnitude. He was able to contend with a serious Kokushibo and inflict significant damage on him and later contributed to the battle against Muzan. His Marked state also grants access to Rage Power and Awakened Power through his Repetitive Action technique.
